name: Brallobarbital
summary: Brallobarbital was a barbiturate developed in the 1920s. It has sedative and hypnotic properties, and was used for the treatment of insomnia. Brallobarbital was primarily sold as part of a combination product called Vesparax, composed of 150 mg secobarbital, 50 mg brallobarbital and 50 mg hydroxyzine.

pharmacology.text: It has sedative and hypnotic properties, and was used for the treatment of insomnia.

uses.text: It has sedative and hypnotic properties, and was used for the treatment of insomnia.

sideEffects.en: Like other barbiturates, it causes drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and confusion. Overdose can stop breathing and be fatal. Regular use brings dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause seizures that can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他巴比妥類一樣，它會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與混亂。過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。規律使用會造成依賴，突然停藥可能引起危及生命的癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他巴比妥类一样，它会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与混乱。过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。规律使用会造成依赖，突然停药可能引起危及生命的癫痫发作。

fact.en: It was sold mainly as part of Vesparax, a combination sleeping tablet. That product became notorious and was eventually withdrawn.
fact.zh: 溴烯巴比妥主要作為複方安眠藥 Vesparax 的成分販售。該產品後來聲名不佳，最終下市。
fact.zhHans: 溴烯巴比妥主要作为复方安眠药 Vesparax 的成分贩售。该产品后来声名不佳，最终下市。
